source.quote: Marantz HD-DAC1 specification sheet and owner's manual, read 2026-11-20: USB type B, two optical and one coaxial, all at 192 kHz / 24-bit, with native DSD2.8 and DSD5.6 over USB. Unusual in this catalogue in that the device itself stops at 192 kHz, so USB holds no advantage over its S/PDIF inputs.
